en: A black-and-white postcard showing the medieval Barbican (Barbakán) of Pécs, a round stone defensive tower and wall surrounded by grass and trees, with a statue standing on a pedestal in front of the fortifications. The reverse side has multilingual caption text (Hungarian, English, Russian), photographer credit, publisher imprint from Budapest, price and postcard layout with lines for address and stamp.
